description: Request a formal quotation for catalog parts. Creates a quote request and returns its reference; Satmarin replies within one working day. This call emails nothing to the requester.

billing_address.description: Optional postal billing address, used only if a proforma invoice is later issued. Free text, newline separated, at most 6 lines and 300 characters. Markup is removed. The country comes from contact.country, not from this field.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the customer, e.g. BE. Case-insensitive. Used for shipping and VAT treatment on the quotation.

vat.description: Optional VAT or tax registration number, e.g. BE0479944518. Letters and digits only, up to 32 characters; spaces, dots and dashes are removed. Not validated against any tax register.

items.description: 1 to 20 lines. Every part number must be a live, quotable catalog product.

notes.description: Optional free text, up to 1000 characters.

name: get_quote
title: Request a quotation
